ruleset.name: sail-test-pending
ruleset.description: The families not yet burned down, as AGENTS.md "Quality gate" lists them with their counts: time in tests (SleepInTest, PipedStreamInTest, ClockReadInTest, TimedWaitInTest), method-level complexity (CognitiveComplexity, CyclomaticComplexity, NPathComplexity, ExcessiveParameterList) and test-class size (NcssCount). A family's rules move to pmd-test.xml, unchanged, in the pull request that makes it clean in every module.

rule.message: The {0} ''{1}'' has a{2} cyclomatic complexity of {3} (limit: 15 per method)
The {0} ''{1}'' has a NCSS line count of {2} (limit: 60 per method, 600 per class)

rule.name: SleepInTest
rule.message: A test does not sleep: wait for the event through ai.singlr.sail.test.Await
rule.description: A test waits for an event, never for time.

rule.name: PipedStreamInTest
rule.message: A piped stream fails when its writer thread exits: use LineSink and FeedableInputStream from ai.singlr.sail.test
rule.description: What the code under test writes goes to a LineSink; what it reads comes from a FeedableInputStream.

rule.name: ClockReadInTest
rule.message: A test does not measure elapsed time: assert the outcome
rule.description: A test never asserts how long something took.

rule.name: TimedWaitInTest
rule.message: A test does not choose its own timeout: wait through ai.singlr.sail.test.Await, which applies the one hang guard
rule.description: A wait ends with the event or with the hang guard shared by every test.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[ArgumentList/*[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit')] or (pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Thread#join(_*)') and ArgumentList/*) or (pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.Object#wait(_*)') and ArgumentList/*) or @MethodName = ('assertTimeout', 'assertTimeoutPreemptively')] [not(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[@SimpleName = 'Await'] and /CompilationUnit/PackageDeclaration[@Name = 'ai.singlr.sail.test'])]
